import { Component, Input } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; import { Task, TaskStatus } from '../../models/task.model'; import { TaskService } from '../../services/task.service'; import { AuthService } from '../../services/auth.service'; /** * Standardized Corporate Executive Task Card Component. * Guaranteed 100% Uniform Size (Fixed 460px Height), Alignment, and Design across Focus, Drifting, and Orbit Zones. * Restricts Ping action trigger to Team Leads & Project Managers (`authService.hasLeadPermissions()`). */ @Component({ selector: 'app-task-card', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `
{{ task.environment }} ({{ task.environmentMultiplier }}x) Overdue Pinged Active
Score {{ task.totalGravityScore }}

#{{ task.id }} - {{ task.title }}

{{ task.description || 'No additional description provided.' }}

Blast Radius {{ task.dependencyScore }} pts ({{ task.directBlockedCount }} direct / {{ task.indirectBlockedCount }} indirect)
Deadline Proximity {{ task.deadlineProximityScore }} pts ({{ task.hoursUntilDeadline }}h left)
Aging / Stagnation {{ task.stagnationScore }} pts ({{ task.hoursInactive }}h inactive)
Assignee Load {{ task.workloadDensityScore }} pts ({{ task.assigneeActiveTasksCount }} active tasks)
{{ task.customFactorName || 'Custom Weight' }} (Applied to Task)
+{{ task.customFactorScore }} pts
Custom Factor: None +0 pts
{{ task.assignee?.fullName?.charAt(0) || 'U' }}
{{ task.assignee?.fullName || 'Unassigned' }}
Pings {{ task.pingCount }}
` }) export class TaskCardComponent { @Input({ required: true }) task!: Task; constructor( public taskService: TaskService, public authService: AuthService ) {} getCardContainerClasses(): string { if (this.task.status === 'DONE') { return 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/20'; } switch (this.task.canvasZone) { case 'FOCUS': return 'border-indigo-300 border-l-4 border-l-indigo-600'; case 'DRIFTING': return 'border-slate-300 border-l-4 border-l-amber-500'; default: return 'border-slate-200 border-l-4 border-l-slate-400'; } } getEnvBadgeClasses(env: string): string { switch (env) { case 'PRODUCTION': return 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200'; case 'STAGING': return 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200'; default: return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200'; } } onPingToggle(): void { if (!this.authService.hasLeadPermissions()) return; this.taskService.pingBlocker(this.task.id).subscribe(); } onStatusChange(newStatus: TaskStatus): void { this.taskService.updateStatus(this.task.id, newStatus).subscribe(); } onDelete(): void { if (confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete Task #${this.task.id}: "${this.task.title}"?`)) { this.taskService.deleteTask(this.task.id).subscribe(); } } }
